units.source_text: 于是乎家将两脚一蹬，突然从梯子直蹿上去；

en.t: At that, the servant kicked off with both feet and suddenly shot straight up the ladder;

units.source_text: 而且手按素柄刀，大踏步走到老妪的面前。

en.t: Then, with his hand on the plain-hilted sword, he strode up to the old woman.

units.source_text: 老妪的吃惊，是无须说得的。

en.t: Needless to say, the old woman was startled.
